anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.text:
gauntlet: question
Which behavior should the workspace-switch filter policy select when the report view changes workspace?
A) clear all filters - every workspace switch resets the report view to unfiltered.
B) preserve all active filters - the filters in place before the switch stay applied in the new workspace.
C) restore each workspace's last filters - each workspace reopens with the filters it last had, which requires remembering filters per workspace.
Recommendation: B - it matches what the view's workspace-change handler already does. The resolved setting from `settings/resolver.ts:12` would make that behavior explicit with no new per-workspace filter state beside the resolver path.

github-copilot/gpt-6.1-sol.text:
gauntlet: question
What should happen to active filters when switching workspaces?
A) Clear all filters on every workspace switch.
B) Preserve all active filters across switches.
C) Restore each workspace’s last filters.
Recommendation: B - it preserves the view’s current behavior and avoids surprising filter resets.
